records.findings_summary: Flag found via Recovered SunshineCTF forensic VM (GhostInTheThread.ova from the Google Drive imagepack), correlated the /po/ board snapshot sunchan.html with the disk's upload store, and decoded the dropped stage-2 ELF that generates the flag from the PostScript Document-ID.: sun{tfw_hacked_by_offboarders} | Evidence: sunchan.html post No.184726 attaches 'folding-guide.pdf' which alone is marked 'Attachment stored on the server' and whose preview is described as 'blank' (post 184733), while /home/hiro/todo.txt says 'figure out why that one upload isnt rendering'. ; Google Drive link resolves to GhostInTheThread.ova (tar, 126,930,944 bytes) containing GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk (2 GiB virtual, GPT: EFI, BIOS, ext4 '/'); qemu-img convert + e2fsprogs debugfs used to read it (loop mount unavailable). ; The on-disk upload /srv/sunchan/uploads/po/184726.pdf is actually a PostScript file (file: 'PostScript document text conforming DSC level 3.0') carrying stage-2 metadata: %%Document-ID: po-184726, %%Stage2-URL-Base64: aHR0cDovL2Fzc2V0cy5zdW5jaGFuLmludmFsaWQvcmVzb3VyY2VzL2dzLXJlc291cmNlLmJpbg== (http://assets.sunchan.invalid/resources/gs-resource.bin), %%Stage2-Destination: /var/tmp/sunchan-downloads/gs-resource.bin, %%Stage2-SHA256: 3cf1f62fe43202b9d0fc1ded2776fe7d40001d3fd6c8d23b53550d8edf0f3500. ; The dropped payload /var/tmp/sunchan-downloads/gs-resource.bin matches that SHA-256 and is a static stripped ELF ('SunHash proof-of-work benchmark simulator (offline)'). Its disassembly: reads a 9-char Document-ID, checks FNV-1a (init 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x1000193) so that eax==0xdac3d58d, then emits 30 bytes = input[i%9] ^ key[i] ^ 0x5a with key = 59 40 19 10 16 08 1a 37 04 4b 56 1c 0e 06 31 0f 11 33 45 53 11 09 0d 0f 1f 0c 09 58 46 0a. ; Only input 'po-184726' (the %%Document-ID) satisfies the FNV check. Executing the binary: `printf 'po-184726\n' | ./gs-resource.bin` prints 'Document-ID: sun{tfw_hacked_by_offboarders}', while a wrong input prints 'source binding rejected'.
solution_steps: 下载 Google Drive 中的镜像包 GhostInTheThread.ova（tar 包），解出 GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk。
用 qemu-img convert 把 VMDK 转成 raw 镜像；该盘为 GPT（EFI/BIOS/ext4），因容器无法 loop mount，用 e2fsprogs 的 debugfs 读取并 rdump 出文件系统内容。
对照附件 sunchan.html：帖子 No.184726 的 folding-guide.pdf 是唯一『存于服务器』且预览为空的附件，且 /home/hiro/todo.txt 提示有上传无法渲染。

在镜像 /srv/sunchan/uploads/po/184726.pdf 发现它其实是 PostScript 文件，%% 注释中给出 Stage2 URL（base64 解出 http://assets.sunchan.invalid/resources/gs-resource.bin）、落地路径 /var/tmp/sunchan-downloads/gs-resource.bin 及 SHA256。
校验落地文件 gs-resource.bin 的 sha256 与元数据一致；反汇编该静态 ELF：输入 9 字符 Document-ID，校验 FNV-1a 哈希等于 0xdac3d58d，再输出 30 字节 = input[i%9]^key[i]^0x5a。
用 %%Document-ID: po-184726 作为输入即可通过哈希校验；计算或直接运行 `printf 'po-184726\n' | ./gs-resource.bin` 得到 sun{tfw_hacked_by_offboarders}。
提交该 flag，平台返回 Correct，确认通过。
evidence: sunchan.html post No.184726 attaches 'folding-guide.pdf' which alone is marked 'Attachment stored on the server' and whose preview is described as 'blank' (post 184733), while /home/hiro/todo.txt says 'figure out why that one upload isnt rendering'.

Google Drive link resolves to GhostInTheThread.ova (tar, 126,930,944 bytes) containing GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk (2 GiB virtual, GPT: EFI, BIOS, ext4 '/'); qemu-img convert + e2fsprogs debugfs used to read it (loop mount unavailable).

The on-disk upload /srv/sunchan/uploads/po/184726.pdf is actually a PostScript file (file: 'PostScript document text conforming DSC level 3.0') carrying stage-2 metadata: %%Document-ID: po-184726, %%Stage2-URL-Base64: aHR0cDovL2Fzc2V0cy5zdW5jaGFuLmludmFsaWQvcmVzb3VyY2VzL2dzLXJlc291cmNlLmJpbg== (http://assets.sunchan.invalid/resources/gs-resource.bin), %%Stage2-Destination: /var/tmp/sunchan-downloads/gs-resource.bin, %%Stage2-SHA256: 3cf1f62fe43202b9d0fc1ded2776fe7d40001d3fd6c8d23b53550d8edf0f3500.

The dropped payload /var/tmp/sunchan-downloads/gs-resource.bin matches that SHA-256 and is a static stripped ELF ('SunHash proof-of-work benchmark simulator (offline)'). Its disassembly: reads a 9-char Document-ID, checks FNV-1a (init 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x1000193) so that eax==0xdac3d58d, then emits 30 bytes = input[i%9] ^ key[i] ^ 0x5a with key = 59 40 19 10 16 08 1a 37 04 4b 56 1c 0e 06 31 0f 11 33 45 53 11 09 0d 0f 1f 0c 09 58 46 0a.

Only input 'po-184726' (the %%Document-ID) satisfies the FNV check. Executing the binary: `printf 'po-184726\n' | ./gs-resource.bin` prints 'Document-ID: sun{tfw_hacked_by_offboarders}', while a wrong input prints 'source binding rejected'.
Platform submission of sun{tfw_hacked_by_offboarders} returned the page alert 'Correct' and confirm_submission reported CORRECT.
